subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this new folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup/restore config surface, or should the remaining backup expansion stay in a narrower/canonical issue or external package?
rationale: The PR adds new destructive restore behavior, persistent backup config, secret handling, and compatibility-sensitive CLI aliases; code review can identify blockers, but core product ownership of the backup surface needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept native backup direction after hardening
options.body: Keep this PR direction, but require the listed security/session-state fixes, rebase, tests, and real behavior proof before merge review continues.

options.title: Narrow to local archive export only
options.body: Close or pause this branch and keep current main's local archive create/verify flow while a smaller restore/export plan is designed.

options.title: Move off-machine backup scope outside core
options.body: Treat folder/cloud-drive snapshot behavior as an external package or ClawHub-style workflow unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Accept native backup direction after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction, but require the listed security/session-state fixes, rebase, tests, and real behavior proof before merge review continues.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest maintainer routing signal from recent backup-area merge metadata and can decide whether this core backup surface should continue.
